_note: ComfyUI API-format workflow for Wan 2.2 I2V-A14B (image-to-video).
Two-stage sampler: high-noise model (early steps) -> low-noise model (refine).
Input: uploaded PNG (1080x1920 from Qwen-Image, resized to 720x1280 by WanImageToVideo).
Output: 720x1280 MP4 @ 16fps. Length controlled by 'length' input (frames).
3.0s = 49 frames, 4.0s = 65 frames, 5.0s = 81 frames (native), 6.0s = 97 frames.
Wan 2.2 was trained on 81 frames — quality drops beyond ~97 frames; cap at 113.
Required files (BF16 full precision, ~40GB+ VRAM total):
models/diffusion_models/ -> wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_bf16.safetensors  (~28GB)
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_high_noise_14B_bf16.safetensors
models/diffusion_models/ -> wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_bf16.safetensors   (~28GB)
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.2_ComfyUI_Repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/diffusion_models/wan2.2_i2v_low_noise_14B_bf16.safetensors
models/text_encoders/    -> umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors                   (~11GB)
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/text_encoders/umt5_xxl_fp16.safetensors
models/vae/              -> wan_2.1_vae.safetensors                     (~250MB)
https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Wan_2.1_ComfyUI_repackaged/resolve/main/split_files/vae/wan_2.1_vae.safetensors
Requires ComfyUI (>= Aug 2025) with native Wan 2.2 nodes + ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite for VHS_VideoCombine.
Render time: ~5-8 min per 5s clip on RTX 4090, ~3-4 min on H100.
Tune knobs (KSampler 1+2 nodes 13 & 14):
- High-noise steps 0-N split: 20 total, 10 each works well. Adjust via 'end_step'.
- CFG: 3.5-5.0. Higher = stronger prompt adherence but more morphing.
- shift: 5.0 for 16fps. Increase to 8.0 for slower motion.

inputs.text: static, frozen, still image, no movement, jittery, low quality, blurry, distorted, deformed face, morphing, melting, warping, glitch artifacts, duplicate frames, text overlay, watermark
